NETWORK_ALIAS_CONFLICT: A confirmed alias would be overwritten, so nothing changes.
NETWORK_CONFIG_MISSING: The Network import configuration is missing.
NETWORK_FILE_NETWORK: The network failed while fetching the handoff file.
NETWORK_FILE_TOO_LARGE: The handoff file is over the size limit.
NETWORK_FILE_URL_REFUSED: The file link is not on the allowed host list.
NETWORK_IDENTITY_CONFLICT: Two people share one identity key, so nothing changes.
NETWORK_NO_HEADER: The handoff file has no header row.
NETWORK_PAGE_INCOMPLETE: A Notion page read did not finish.
NETWORK_READBACK_MISMATCH: A write did not read back as written.
NETWORK_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: The Network database no longer has the properties the import writes.
NETWORK_STORE_FAILED: The import could not be stored.
NETWORK_SURFACE_PAGE_INCOMPLETE: A surface page read did not finish.
NETWORK_DESCRIPTION_READBACK_MISMATCH: After removing a repeated job description, the row's blocks did not read back as expected.
Open the row; nothing else was removed. The next run checks it again.
NETWORK_SURFACE_READBACK_MISMATCH: A surface write did not read back as written.
COMPANY_CHANGED: Network event: a person's company changed.
PERSON_IMPORTED: Network event: a person was imported.
SHEET_VIA_CHATGPT: Network source kind: a sheet handed off through ChatGPT.
TITLE_CHANGED: Network event: a person's title changed.
